spec_evidence.checked: GitHub commit patch for discovery/walletobjects-v1.json fetched and read line by line. Patch adds one optional response property sha512Hash to a media schema and bumps revision. Purely additive; no existing field removed or retyped.

fix.migration_guide: All ten google entries in this release cite the same generator PR #3920 (commit 08443b4). The 'BREAKING CHANGES' banner comes from release-please propagating a breaking marker from other packages in the monorepo commit (aiplatform et al.) into every lockstep major bump; this package's own discovery diff was verified line by line from the GitHub commit patch and contains no removal, rename, retype, or new required field. Patch adds one optional response property sha512Hash to a media schema and bumps revision. Purely additive; no existing field removed or retyped. No consumer code change is required; the major version number alone is not a breaking API surface change for this package.
